The raw_customers table contains numeric region codes ('01'–'04') alongside the region names. raw_region_map gives an explicit, unambiguous mapping: 01→WEST, 02→EAST, 03→NORTH, 04→SOUTH. The fix is to map codes to names in silver_customers using a left join to raw_region_map, falling back to upper(region) for values that are already names.

The map's region_code values are all distinct, so the join cannot duplicate rows. The output columns stay the same. Customers whose region is already a name don't match any code and keep upper(region).

gold_region_daily reads from silver_customers, so it corrects itself once silver is fixed.
